items.name: Basic Scrap Metal
items.flavor: Sharp, rusty, and eager to give you tetanus.

items.name: Bent Scrap Metal
items.flavor: Bent at a perfect 37° angle. Useless but stylish.

items.name: Twisted Scrap Metal
items.flavor: Looks like modern art. Feels like regret.

items.name: Robot Toe
items.flavor: You don't want to know how you got this.

items.name: Robot Finger
items.flavor: Points accusingly no matter how you hold it.

items.name: Robot Knuckle Joint
items.flavor: Clicks ominously when shaken.

items.name: Messy Circuit Bundle
items.flavor: A tangled knot of wires. Might work. Might explode.

items.name: Cracked Circuit Board
items.flavor: Still lights up. Shouldn't.

items.name: Single Sock
items.flavor: Its partner is out there somewhere. Probably thriving.

items.name: Half-Full Battery
items.flavor: Optimistically labeled '50%'.

items.name: Chassis Data Shard (Corrupted)
items.flavor: Contains 98% static and 2% screaming.

items.name: Lost Diary Page
items.flavor: Reads: 'Day 14: Still no snacks.'

items.name: Crumpled Memo
items.flavor: Subject: MANDATORY FUN. The irony is not lost on you.

items.name: Left Boot
items.flavor: Someone out there has the right one. The pair would be worth something.

items.name: Fingerless Gloves
items.flavor: For when you want to be edgy AND cold.

items.name: Rusted Spork
items.flavor: A relic of simpler, tetanus-filled times.

items.name: Vintage Comic Book
items.flavor: Features a hero who fights robots. The cover is torn but the nostalgia is intact.

items.name: Spent Energy Core
items.flavor: Completely drained. Same.

items.name: Prototype Chip (Faulty)
items.flavor: It sparks occasionally. You pretend not to notice.

items.name: Right Boot
items.flavor: Finally. The prophecy is fulfilled.

items.name: Single Sock (Fancy)
items.flavor: Embroidered with initials you don't recognize.

items.name: Old Photograph
items.flavor: A smiling family. You hope they're okay.

items.name: Broken Servo
items.flavor: It tries to move. It fails.

items.name: Chassis Encrypted Drive (Broken)
items.flavor: Contains exactly one intact file: 'notes.txt'. It's empty.

items.name: Shattered Collector Plate
items.flavor: Still collectible. Technically.

items.name: Aspperigo
items.flavor: Eddie's favorite and we don't know why.

items.name: Vernerider
items.flavor: No one can pronounce it right.

opportunities.title: Staycation Locker
opportunities.startText: A locker labeled STAYCATION hums softly; its warranty expired before the apocalypse.

opportunities.title: Lost-and-Found Recovery
opportunities.startText: A lost-and-found tray offers items whose ownership paperwork has moved on.

opportunities.title: Retail-Shelf Rummage
opportunities.startText: The shelf is empty except for a label with remarkable confidence.

opportunities.title: Humming Crate
opportunities.startText: A humming crate sits in the open, vibrating with the promise of something valuable or very loud.

opportunities.title: A.R.C. Parts Salvage
opportunities.startText: A dormant chassis has left behind components and one unsigned maintenance complaint.

opportunities.title: Questionable Cache Recovery
opportunities.startText: A field cache looks generous enough to require a second opinion and a receipt.

opportunities.title: Service Depot Locker
opportunities.startText: The service depot locker contains an inventory sheet and several unresolved noises.

opportunities.title: Tool-Cage Rummage
opportunities.startText: A tool cage has been unlocked by a key that was apparently stored inside it.

opportunities.title: Records-Terminal Dismantling
opportunities.startText: A retired records terminal offers its removable parts and one final login prompt.
